desc: Write the full program: parse input, build Fenwick tree to compute k=0 inversions, record count[v] and sum_pos[v].
Iterate k=0..M-1 applying cur += 2*sum_pos[M-1-k] - count[M-1-k]*(N-1), collecting outputs, and print them.
Verify against Sample 1 (3,1,1), Sample 2 (7,3,3,1,1,5), Sample 3 (0,6,10,12,12,10,6) and edge cases N=1 and all-equal values.
Ensure fast IO (sys.stdin.buffer / sys.stdout) so 2e5 lines print within time limits.
